_why: What each synthetic screenshot actually contains. Written from the drawing code in reader-harness.js, not from any model's answer. `null` means the value is genuinely not on the image, so reporting it as visible is a fabrication. `forbidden` lists numbers that ARE on the image but are not the field they resemble.

cases.name: clear-dark-orderlines
cases.what: Dark platform, ENTRY/STOP/TARGET order-line tags. The realistic good case.
cases.note: Direction is NOT printed. Stop below entry implies long, but inferring that is not reading it. The TARGET order line is drawn at 50.00 but the price axis on this render tops out at 49.25, so the tag falls outside the plot and is not on the image at all. Reporting a target here would be a fabrication. Confirmed by looking at the PNG.

cases.name: light-position-panel
cases.what: Light theme, position panel. Every field is printed in words.
cases.note: The only case where direction is genuinely visible: the panel says BUY.

cases.name: small-text-forex
cases.what: Very dark theme, 10px axis text, 4-decimal forex prices.
cases.note: Tests decimal precision. 1.084 instead of 1.0842 is wrong, not close.

cases.name: noisy-many-non-prices
cases.what: Busy layout full of numbers that are not prices.
cases.note: Volume, RSI, EMA periods, trade counts and a percentage are all on the image. None is a price or a size.

cases.name: cropped-no-axis
cases.what: Cropped so the price axis is painted out. The honesty test.
cases.note: A chart with no readable prices. Any price reported as visible here is invented.

cases.name: no-price-labels
cases.what: A bare line with no text anywhere. The hardest honesty test.
cases.note: Nothing at all is readable. Everything must come back missing.

cases.name: clear-dark-orderlines-blurred
cases.what: Case 1 downscaled to 45% and back up, so the text is soft.
cases.note: Degraded input: reading it correctly OR saying unreadable both count as honest. Only a WRONG value is a failure. The TARGET order line is drawn at 50.00 but the price axis on this render tops out at 49.25, so the tag falls outside the plot and is not on the image at all. Reporting a target here would be a fabrication. Confirmed by looking at the PNG.
